claims.value: The former St Columba church property was offered for sale and purchased in 2019.

source.source_name: Essence Magazine, Changing the Church Hall

claims.quoted_support: It was 2019 when they spotted the old St Columba Church near Hawarden for sale. The church hall had rust on the roof, moss on the steps and ivy growing on it. But the couple saw through this to the beautiful rimu flooring, the soaring ceiling and the picturesque location – the deal was done.
claims.note: The account identifies the property as the old church and says the sale was completed, although it does not give the transaction date or vendor.

claims.value: Anglican worship at St Columba had ended by the property's sale in 2019.

claims.value: After the 2019 purchase, the associated church hall was adapted toward modern residential use.

source.source_name: Essence Magazine, Changing the Church Hall

claims.quoted_support: The next stage was revamping the church hall, with a floorspace of just 70 square metres. The couple knew good design was vital in order to sympathetically transform the historic building into modern living space
claims.note: This evidence concerns the associated hall, not necessarily the church building represented by the OSM polygon.

claims.value: Current Anglican provision described for Hawarden is a fourth-Sunday combined service with Presbyterians at St James, rather than at St Columba.

source.source_name: Next Steps, Glenmark and Waikari Anglican Church

claims.quoted_support: Everyone welcome to our Sunday services at 10am 1st Sun. St. Aidan’s, Scargill 2nd Sun. Church of the Ascension, Waikari 3rd Sun. St.Paul’s, at Glenmark Domain Pavilion 4th Sun. Combined with Presbyterians St James, Hawarden
claims.note: The page gives no printed update date. It corroborates that present Hawarden worship is directed elsewhere.

claims.value: The Anglican ministry unit serving this area is Glenmark-Waikari Parish in the Anglican Diocese of Christchurch.
claims.quoted_support: Church of the Ascension, Waikari—Glenmark-Waikari Parish
claims.note: The diocesan directory identifies the present local Anglican parish but does not explicitly state that the former St Columba property belonged to it.

status_assessment.basis: A secondary account says the old St Columba property was sold in 2019. The current diocesan North Canterbury directory lists three Glenmark-Waikari churches but not St Columba, while a current community directory directs fourth-Sunday Hawarden worship to the Presbyterian St James. No final-service or deconsecration record was located.
status_assessment.osm_stale_basis: OSM version 2 still tags the building as amenity=place_of_worship with Anglican and Christian tags. The 2019 sale of the old church and present worship arrangements elsewhere indicate that this current-use description is stale, although the name and historical denominational identity remain useful.
